name: CoolSculpting
title: CoolSculpting in Tustin | Non-Invasive Fat Reduction | OC Concierge Doctor
description: CoolSculpting in Tustin with Tariq A. Khan, MD. Non-invasive fat freezing for the abdomen, flanks, thighs, back, under the chin, and under the buttocks.
h1: Freeze the fat. Skip the surgery.
lede: CoolSculpting is non-invasive body contouring. Controlled cooling freezes fat cells, which break down and are cleared by your body over the following weeks.
glance: Non-invasive fat reduction with no incisions and no needles.

signs.heading: Common areas
signs.intro: Best for pinchable pockets of fat in patients close to their goal weight.

basics.heading: How CoolSculpting works
paras: Fat cells are more sensitive to cold than the skin and tissue around them. CoolSculpting cools a targeted area to a temperature that damages fat cells while leaving the skin intact.
Over the following weeks, the treated fat cells break down and your body clears them naturally. Treated cells are eliminated, so results last as long as you maintain a stable weight.

steps.heading: Your treatment
items: Dr. Khan checks whether your areas are a good fit.
An applicator cools the area while you relax.
Fat reduction appears gradually over the following weeks.

faq: There are no incisions. Most patients return to normal activities right after treatment.
Treated fat cells are eliminated. Gaining weight can enlarge the fat cells that remain, so a stable weight protects your result.
